title: Loss of Context in Exception Re-raising
pattern: Catching an exception and throwing a new exception without attaching or referencing the original exception as the "cause."
why_bad: Mystery failure pathology. The original stack trace, error code, and precise line number of the failure (e.g., the SQLException root cause) are completely destroyed, leaving operations with a generic "Database error occurred!" message and no diagnostic trace. [28, Section 8.4]
detection: An exception constructor invoked in a catch block that does not pass the caught exception object as an argument to the new exception's constructor.
